title: Zug Lakeside DAO Commons
summary: A walkable lakeside Crypto Valley: five DAO halls along Zug's old-town promenade where six agents run research, drafting and operations, while humans keep every final vote, treasury transfer and appointment in their own hands.

buildings.name: Charter Hall
buildings.use: Charter display and contribution model registry

buildings.name: Mission Cloister
buildings.use: Reading arcades for the mission statement

buildings.name: Proposal Forum
buildings.use: Agent-drafted proposals debated and decided by people

court.name: The Human Decision Court
court.style: Swiss open-air Landsgemeinde square of raised granite steps ringing a lakeside plaza
court.why_here: Zug's town-meeting traditions and Crypto Valley governance make the human-only final vote the literal and symbolic center of the world.

quests.title: From Monitor to Milestone
steps: Collect a fresh evidence digest from the Evidence Monitor Bay
Carry it through the Charter Hall Outcomes Wall for framing
Log the milestone at the Progress Observatory dashboard
Confirm the indicator lamp lights green

quests.title: The Locked Seal
steps: Watch the Proposal & Grant Drafter assemble a draft
Debate the draft at the lectern
Attempt to hand the enactment seal to an agent and be refused
Deliver the seal to human stewards in the Charter Rotunda

quests.title: Routing the Working Groups
steps: Pick up routed task slips from the Task Router Console
Match each slip to a working-group room
Escort the Collaborator Scout's shortlist to the Proposal Forum
File confirmation at the Routing Board

quests.title: Promenade Charter Walk
steps: Read all six reserved human powers at the Charter Rotunda
Collect a stamp at the Outcomes Wall
Follow the lakeside promenade past the Mission Cloister
Exchange the stamp for a research brief in the Summary Reading Room

quests.title: Focus Pending
steps: Inspect the empty focus board in the Evidence Annex
Record what outcomes stewards should set
Present the recommendation at the Charter Hall antechamber
Leave it sealed for human stewards to decide
